entries.title: Psalms 25:1
segments: <<A Psalm of David.>> Unto thee, O Jehovah, do I lift up my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 25:2
segments: O my God, in thee have I trusted, Let me not be put to shame; Let not mine enemies triumph over me.

entries.title: Psalms 25:3
segments: Yea, none that wait for thee shall be put to shame: They shall be put to shame that deal treacherously without cause.

entries.title: Psalms 25:4
segments: Show me thy ways, O Jehovah; Teach me thy paths.

entries.title: Psalms 25:5
segments: Guide me in thy truth, and teach me; For thou art the God of my salvation; For thee do I wait all the day.

entries.title: Psalms 25:6
segments: Remember, O Jehovah, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindness; For they have been ever of old.

entries.title: Psalms 25:7
segments: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: According to thy lovingkindness remember thou me, For thy goodness' sake, O Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 25:8
segments: Good and upright is Jehovah: Therefore will he instruct sinners in the way.

entries.title: Psalms 25:9
segments: The meek will he guide in justice; And the meek will he teach his way.

entries.title: Psalms 25:10
segments: All the paths of Jehovah are lovingkindness and truth Unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 25:11
segments: For thy name's sake, O Jehovah, Pardon mine iniquity, for it is great.

entries.title: Psalms 25:12
segments: What man is he that feareth Jehovah? Him shall he instruct in the way that he shall choose.

entries.title: Psalms 25:13
segments: His soul shall dwell at ease; And his seed shall inherit the land.

entries.title: Psalms 25:14
segments: The friendship of Jehovah is with them that fear him; And he will show them his covenant.

entries.title: Psalms 25:15
segments: Mine eyes are ever toward Jehovah; For he will pluck my feet out of the net.

entries.title: Psalms 25:16
segments: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; For I am desolate and afflicted.

entries.title: Psalms 25:17
segments: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: Oh bring thou me out of my distresses.

entries.title: Psalms 25:18
segments: Consider mine affliction and my travail; And forgive all my sins.

entries.title: Psalms 25:19
segments: Consider mine enemies, for they are many; And they hate me with cruel hatred.

entries.title: Psalms 25:20
segments: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me: Let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in thee.

entries.title: Psalms 25:21
segments: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, For I wait for thee.

entries.title: Psalms 25:22
segments: Redeem Israel, O God, Out all of his troubles.
